description_en: Retrieves the information about an organizational unit
description_zh: 调用GetOrganizationalUnit接口，获取指定组织的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun eiam-developerapi get-organizational-unit --authorization Bearer_AT8csE2seYxxxxxij --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --organizational-unit-id ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetOrganizationalUnit

parameters.help_en: The authentication information. Format: Bearer ${access_token}. Example: Bearer ATxxxx
parameters.help_zh:
认证信息。
格式：Bearer ${access_token}。
示例：Bearer ATxxxx
parameters.name: authorization

parameters.help_en: The ID of the organizational unit
parameters.name: organizational_unit_id

createTime.description_en: The time when the organizational unit was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
createTime.description_zh: 创建时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

description.description_en: The description of the organizational unit

organizationalUnitExternalId.description_en: The external ID of the organizational unit

organizationalUnitId.description_en: The ID of the organizational unit

organizationalUnitName.description_en: The name of the organizational unit

organizationalUnitSourceId.description_en: The source ID of the organizational unit

organizationalUnitSourceType.description_en:
The source type of the organizational unit. Valid values:

build_in: The organizational unit was created in Identity as a Service (IDaaS).

ding_talk: The organizational unit was imported from DingTalk.

ad: The organizational unit was imported from Microsoft Active Directory (AD).

ldap: The organizational unit was imported from a Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) service
organizationalUnitSourceType.description_zh:
来源类型，取值可选范围：
build_in - 自建。
ding_talk - 钉钉导入。
ad  -  AD导入。
ldap  -  LDAP导入

parentId.description_en: The ID of the parent organizational unit

updateTime.description_en: The time when the organizational unit was last updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
updateTime.description_zh: 最近更新时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
updateTime.title_en: 最近一次更新时间，毫秒
updateTime.title_zh: 最近一次更新时间，毫秒
